key_insight: RPCS-VMS suppresses spurious pressure oscillations in equal-order incompressible-flow discretizations while improving pressure accuracy near open boundaries.
engineering_relevance: The scheme supports accurate outlet-flow and pressure predictions with four sequential linear solves per time step.
method: Add residual-based variational multiscale stabilization to pressure-increment and pressure-recovery equations.
Construct stage-specific momentum residuals using a common intermediate-velocity acceleration.
Combine rotational pressure correction with first- or second-order backward differentiation.
evidence_signal: Manufactured solutions show second-order velocity and approximately 1.5-order pressure spatial L2 convergence; pipe and cylinder benchmarks agree closely with references, with a 2.41× wall-time speedup over the tested monolithic VMS solver in the 3D cylinder case.
watch_item: The theoretical guarantees apply to a reduced BDF1 Oseen model with frozen stabilization coefficients, and the pressure-gradient bound is conditional.
paper_title: A variational multiscale rotational pressure-correction method for incompressible flows with open boundaries
